blocks.text: Why a Chauffeur Makes Sense in Placentia
Three practical reasons, specific to this city.
blocks.html: Three practical reasons, specific to this city.

items: Placentia is a quiet bedroom community wedged between Fullerton and Yorba Linda with essentially no nightlife or late dining of its own, so groups almost always drive out, which is the textbook case for a chauffeured round trip.
Small residential streets and one downtown commercial strip mean a coach is hard to park legally, so drop-and-go staging beats parking.
SR 57 and SR 91 run right through the city, and Angel Stadium is roughly 3-4 miles away with sell-out parking.

blocks.text: We also quote Placentia to the hour rather than the trip. Most groups need four hours, and four is the standard minimum across the industry because a committed vehicle cannot be sold to anyone else while it is parked at your venue. If your night genuinely needs less, ask for a one-way transfer rate instead of paying a full minimum.

blocks.text: Choosing a Vehicle for a Placentia Night

Capacity is the first filter, then cost per person. A stretch limo seats 6 to 8, a Chrysler 300 about 8, a Hummer 12, and a Sprinter limo up to 14. Our party bus seats 24. Below about ten people, two cars or a limo usually beats a bus. Above ten, the bus wins on cost per head and nobody gets left behind.
